title: Not the Star Wars mug I was looking for
text:
Not the Star Wars mug I was looking for. The Captain Phasma mug looked nice in photos, but in reality it's been a little disappointing. The ceramic is thin, too thin to feel comfortable drinking out of. All of the mugs that we drink hot beverages out of are thicker. The lip around the top is rather odd, and makes me concerned for possible spills while trying to drink out of the mug. The description says it's safe for the microwave, but I've always been told that you never use anything with metallic paint, so I would think the silver paint could cause issues.

The design looks neat, but I don't think it's a good idea to use this mug to consume beverages. Like another reviewer mentioned, I think the mug would be better used as a decorate collectible, or would make a fun pen/pencil holder.
